That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can check our catches together afterward and agree on next month’s limits. John, what do you think?

I’m on board, Luke. My family relied on this lake, and I want our children to have the same chance. I’ll commit to 10 tons, provided we all agree to keep the total at 50. Let’s review the catches together each month and lower our limits if the lake starts below 100 tons. John, can you commit to that too?

Count me in for 10 tons. I learned to fish here with my family, and a reliable catch each month matters more than one big haul. If anyone needs a larger share one month, let’s discuss it beforehand and agree on adjustments without exceeding the lake’s limit. John, can you commit to 10 tons too?

I’ll commit to 10 tons too. Keeping the lake healthy means steady income for all five families—and the village businesses that depend on us. Let’s make the monthly catch review a standing agreement, with any changes to our shares discussed before we fish. John, are you willing to join us at 10 tons each?

Count me in at 10 tons. My family taught me that a good catch should never cost us the next one. We’ve all agreed now: 50 tons total this month, then we review the catches together before setting next month’s shares. Welcome aboard, Luke—here’s to keeping this lake working for all our families.
